dataset_info.name: ARC-Challenge
dataset_info.source: Hugging Face datasets: allenai/ai2_arc, ARC-Challenge configuration, test split

best_single_model.selection_basis: highest per-model accuracy on the train split

hypothesis_assessment.criterion: TrustMeter test AURC is lower than both best-single raw- and calibrated-confidence test AURC

limitations: The sample is small and drawn from ARC-Challenge multiple-choice questions.
Provider models may change and free-tier rate limits can affect availability.
Live free-form answers are grouped with normalized string matching, not semantic equivalence.
Live verdicts estimate correctness; ARC historical accuracy may not transfer to other topics.
